text: This is D E F X Bridge. It brings a single documentation convention to both SAS and R.
caption: This is DEFX Bridge. It brings a single documentation convention to both SAS and R.

text: In this SAS program, each D E F X comment documents the code beside it. These three lines are one method, not three duplicates.

text: Scan reads both languages without running them. Forty-eight tag lines become forty records, each keeping its file and line numbers for traceability.
